His biggest concern is that if he takes on a project with no profit in it and then when a retail project
comes along our guys are already pulled away on the BELL.

However, he also acknowledged that Jeffrey runs in the best of circles, and he could probably help us by
sending us more business and other projects.

  Dear Larry,



To re-do your Bell 430 with the Bentley style interior provided,
including the paint stripes, the seat change and EVERYTHING else you
requested we would be right at $200,000 dollars.



The 9 extra hides which you have offered will NOT help, as we would
require 9 hides before we even made it to the 6 seats. You do not want
to run the risk of the hides not matching if you try to use a different
die lot either.



If we can firm things up quickly and order the materials now, in
advance, we will be able to turn it around in 30 days or less. If you
want to go forward I will send someone to Palm Beach with some leather
and wood samples to match up the Bentley.



Let me know your thoughts after your meeting with Jeffrey.
